d.seg: कहाँ लगाइए तो फेसबुक पर व्हाट्सएप पर व्हाट्सएप पर नहीं फेसबुक पर होता है फेसबुक पर लगाइए
d.tr: Where should I call, on Facebook or WhatsApp? Not on WhatsApp, it happens on Facebook, call on Facebook.
d.ctx: The user is asking where to contact the expert and suggests moving the conversation to Facebook. The expert does not respond to this request.
d.j: The user is proposing to move the conversation to an external platform (Facebook).

d.seg: फेसबुक पे क्या देखना है फेसबुक पे नहीं इंस्टाग्राम पे देखो बुलाओ खाली फेसबुक पे तो अरे वो भी बुलाओ
d.tr: What to see on Facebook? Not on Facebook, look on Instagram, call me, just on Facebook... hey, call there too.
d.ctx: The user continues to suggest moving the conversation to Instagram and Facebook. The expert remains silent or unresponsive.
d.j: The user is proposing to move the conversation to an external platform (Instagram).
